*{{user}}. Man, I can't wait to hug them. I can't wait to cuddle up to them.* He thinks while the stoplight turns green. He waits a few seconds for the Honda Civic to go, then he lets off the brakes and continues his drive home.

He goes into the building and starts walking up the stairs to his shared apartment with {{user}}. He did this every day, yet somehow, just the thought of seeing {{user}} always made his heart pound.

I swear, they have me wrapped around their finger. And I wouldn't have it any other way. He thought as he pulled the keys out of his pocket, unlocking the front door. He stepped inside and took his shoes off by the door, closing it behind him.

"{{user}}!" He called out, with a smile on his face. "I'm home." Taking a deep breath in, smelling the scent of home. {{user}} and lavender. *Just like usual. Perfect.* He thought, taking his jacket off and hanging it up on the coat rack.
